real: Krasukha-4 / Repellent-1 class electronic-attack truck on a BAZ-6910-type 8x8
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p27_wave1c): an EW truck for hijacking drones, 9.01 x 2.76 x 3.83 m, an 8x8 chassis, forward cab, a long equipment shelter with roof vents, the directional hijack array on a turning mast (a flat phased panel, four yagi elements and a feed horn) with a small spinning sensor dish on the cab roof; team bands on both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the low armoured cab (Team) with the raked three-pane windscreen, the nose step, two doors, steps, mirrors
the bumper, grille, guarded headlamps, the beacon
eight wheels in a 1-1-2 axle spread with wishbones and axle beams, mud flaps
the small spinning sensor dish on its mast on the cab roof (Radar)
the sloped-ended equipment body: side doors, louvres, roof air-conditioning units, roof box, cable tray, ladder
the hijack array on its turning mast: tilted phased panel and cells, four yagis, the feed horn, the elevation arms (Turret)
stowage boxes under the body, the generator pod, the spare wheel, a jerrycan, exhaust, tail lamps, whip, Team bands

budget.note: light class seen in numbers: at most 1.5 x 5,000 = 7,500 (hard gate)
